en.headline: Air-conditioner fire at Taikoo Shing sends 16 to hospital
en.dek: A suspected short-circuit in a split-type air-conditioner on the 20th floor of Begonia Mansion at Harbour View Gardens caused heavy smoke on Sunday afternoon; about 300 residents were evacuated and more than 20 waited…
body: Firefighters used one hose and a breathing-apparatus team to extinguish a blaze that broke out around 2.56pm on Sunday in a unit on the 20th floor of Begonia Mansion at Taikoo Shing’s Harbour View Gardens. Police said the fire was believed to have started from a short-circuit in a living-room split-type air-conditioner and that no foul play was suspected.

Sixteen people aged 15 to 95 felt unwell after inhaling smoke; 13 were taken to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital and three to Ruttonjee Hospital. More than 20 residents took shelter on the rooftop while roughly 300 people left the building. The area was reopened to residents by about 5pm.
The balcony ceiling of the affected unit was blackened by smoke. Fire services stopped mobilisation at 3.58pm after the fire was brought under control.

zh.headline: 太古城海棠閣冷氣機起火 16人不適送院
zh.dek: 周日下午海景花園海棠閣20樓單位懷疑分體式冷氣機電線短路起火，冒出大量濃煙，約300人疏散，逾20人暫上天台，16人不適送院。
body: 消防處周日下午約2時56分接報，太古城海景花園海棠閣20樓一單位起火，出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，於3時58分停止動員。警方初步調查相信是客廳分體式冷氣機電線短路引起，事件沒有可疑。
共16名介乎15至95歲人士吸入濃煙不適，其中13人由救護車送往東區醫院，3人送往律敦治醫院。約300人疏散，逾20人暫上天台等候。下午近5時現場解封，住戶可返回居所。
涉事單位露台天花板被熏黑。
